value_input_option.RAW: The input isn't parsed and is inserted as a string. For example, the input "=1+2" places the string, not the formula, "=1+2" in the cell.

insert_data_option.INSERT_ROWS: Rows are inserted for the new data.
insert_data_option.OVERWRITE: The new data overwrites existing data in the areas it is written.

range: The A1 notation of a range to search for a logical table of data. Values are appended after the last row of the table, starting with the first column of the table.

response_fields.tableRange: The range (in A1 notation) of the table that values are being appended to (before the values were appended). Empty if no table was found.

read_response: GET .../values/{range} answers {range, majorDimension, values}, values omitted when the range is empty
